name: Password Breaker
blurb: Works out an account's password one character at a time.

name: Password Breaker
blurb: Twice as fast as version 1, and can take on stronger passwords.

name: Proxy Bypass
blurb: Slips past a proxy so you can change records and logs.

name: Firewall Bypass
blurb: Opens a path through a firewall so you can copy and delete files.

name: File Copier
blurb: Copies a file to your gateway.

name: File Deleter
blurb: Deletes a file from a server.

name: Log Deleter
blurb: Removes one line from an access log.

name: Trace Tracker
blurb: Shows how far a trace has got and how long you have left.

name: Monitor Bypass
blurb: Blinds a server's monitor for a short while. Nothing you do is noticed, and a running trace stands still. Works once per connection.

name: Monitor Bypass
blurb: Twice as fast as version 1, keeps a monitor blind for twice as long, and can take on stronger monitors.

name: Decrypter
blurb: Opens an encrypted file you have copied to your gateway. Runs at home, so nobody is watching while it works.
